convert_pop2piano_weights_to_hf: convert official pop2piano checkpoint weights to huggingface transformers format and save as pytorch_model.bin
build_pop2piano_model: build a Pop2PianoForConditionalGeneration model from pretrained config and load converted state dict weights
create_tokenizer_vocab: create a tokenizer vocab dictionary by building encoder and decoder mappings from midi token indices
run_tokenize_midi_index: run the tokenize function to convert midi token type and index into a single integer token id
run_detokenize_midi_index: run the detokenize function to convert a token id back into token type and original index
